Quadrant Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Computers (AAPL) by 5.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quadrant Capital Management Llc sold 1,806 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 30,616 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.12 million, down from 32,422 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quadrant Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Computers for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.70% or $1.31 during the last trading session, reaching $187.36. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
